keys.name: ready
keys.pose: standing in the mess the flood left, arms down, looking at the stalk
keys.lineOfAction: a slight C, plumb enough to read as waiting
keys.changes: the entry; she is about to reach

keys.name: reach
keys.pose: the right arm out to the stalk, the hand closing on it, the back foot planted
keys.lineOfAction: one C leaning toward the stalk
keys.changes: pull back, then out; the hand lands on the stalk on 432

keys.name: stack
keys.pose: both hands at the chest holding a stack of three patches
keys.lineOfAction: a small C bowed over the stack
keys.changes: the hands come up together; the stack collapses while she holds the pose

keys.name: sit
keys.pose: sunk to the floor in the mess, folded forward, forearms crossed over the knees
keys.lineOfAction: one deep C folded over the knees
keys.changes: the hips sink and the spine folds; she stays down to the cut
